verdict.rationale: Agent-readable docs are a fair axis for an inference cloud, but probes show no llms.txt (HTTP 404), no markdown docs (HTTP 404) and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. Nothing in the docs evidence mentions agent-oriented documentation; OpenAI-SDK compatibility is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
